postings.title: Systems Engineer I - Signal Processing (Onsite)
top_requirements: Design and implement signal processing algorithms for satellite communication payloads, including modulation/demodulation and error correction coding.
Perform hardware bring‑up and validation of RF front‑end and baseband boards, measuring parameters such as noise figure, gain, and EVM.
Develop and execute system‑level test plans, including link‑budget analysis and over‑the‑air verification of modem performance.
postings.summary: The role focuses on end‑to‑end signal‑processing development for geostationary satellite communications, matching the candidate's experience in modem design and RF testing. It offers hands‑on hardware work in a defense environment.

postings.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Audio Systems, XR
top_requirements: Design and optimize real‑time audio DSP pipelines for XR headsets, including spatial audio rendering and low‑latency codec integration.
Perform hardware bring‑up and acoustic measurements to validate audio quality metrics such as THD, SNR, and spatial localization accuracy.
Develop firmware and driver stacks in C/C++ for custom audio ASICs, ensuring tight integration with XR system hardware.
postings.summary: Google’s senior audio systems role requires deep DSP and hardware integration expertise, which aligns with the candidate’s background in modem and signal‑processing design, offering a high‑compensation, hands‑on position.

postings.title: Systems Algorithm Engineer
top_requirements: Design custom mixed‑signal ASIC blocks for high‑performance perception sensors, including ADC front‑ends and on‑chip DSP pipelines.
Develop and validate silicon prototypes in a fast‑prototype environment, performing silicon bring‑up, characterization, and yield analysis.
Collaborate with algorithm teams to co‑design hardware‑software interfaces for real‑time sensor data processing in robotics applications.
postings.summary: Lyte AI’s role centers on building custom silicon for perception systems, offering the candidate a transition to senior IC design while leveraging their RF and signal‑processing background. The position is highly hands‑on.

postings.title: Engineer Sr, Applied Research Science
top_requirements: Research and implement advanced AI/ML‑based audio signal processing algorithms for real‑time microphone array enhancement.
Design and validate DSP firmware on custom ASICs, measuring metrics such as SNR improvement, beamforming accuracy, and latency.
Collaborate with hardware and software teams to integrate algorithmic solutions into production audio products and conduct field testing.
postings.summary: While focused on audio, this senior applied research role requires strong DSP and hardware bring‑up skills, aligning with the candidate’s modem and signal‑processing experience. It offers a hands‑on engineering environment.

postings.title: Electrical Engineer
top_requirements: Design and prototype underwater acoustic modems, including transducer interface circuits and baseband DSP algorithms for high‑bandwidth data transmission.
Perform hardware bring‑up and sea‑trial testing, characterizing acoustic channel loss, multipath, and data error rates.
Develop firmware in C/C++ for real‑time signal processing, error correction, and power management on custom PCB platforms.
postings.summary: The position leverages the candidate’s communications and modem design expertise in a new domain (underwater acoustics) while remaining hands‑on with hardware and DSP development.

postings.title: Electrical Engineer/Radio Frequency (RF) Engineer with Security Clearance
top_requirements: Design and analyze RF front‑end circuits for aviation communication, navigation, and surveillance systems, ensuring compliance with FAA standards.
Perform link‑budget calculations, antenna matching, and EMI/EMC testing for high‑reliability aerospace applications.
Lead hardware bring‑up and validation of prototype RF modules, using spectrum analyzers and vector network analyzers to verify performance.
postings.summary: The Leidos RF Engineer role focuses on aerospace RF systems, offering hands‑on circuit design and testing that aligns with the candidate’s RF and communications experience, though still within the aerospace sector.
